# NodWeb

> NodWeb designs and builds fast, modern websites for local businesses in Bucharest, Romania — including interactive 3D model showcases for architecture and design studios.

NodWeb is a freelance web design practice based in Bucharest. This site includes live, fully-functional template examples that demonstrate the kind of site a client would receive; NodWeb has not yet delivered a real client project.

## Pages

- [Home](https://nodweb.org/): Services, process, and how to request a quote.
- [Architecture Studio template example](https://nodweb.org/templates/architecture-studio/): A demo site for an architecture studio, featuring an interactive 3D model viewer (rotate, zoom, and view in AR).
- [Local Business template example](https://nodweb.org/templates/local-business/): A demo site for a café or similar local business, featuring a menu grid, hours & location, and a reservation form.
